entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, Mako-chan.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I didn't realize we take the same train.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Haru...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: What a coincidence—I was just thinking[n]of you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Oh, were you?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Yep.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: How should I put this... Our battles from[n]this point forward are only going to get[n]tougher, right?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, I've been reflecting on our[n]approaches to combat in the hopes[n]of finding some new tactics.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In the end, I came up with something,[n]but I realized I'll need your help with it.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Me?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Sure! If I can be of any help, I'd love[n]to work with you on this!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I appreciate it. So... what I'm thinking is...

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mako-chan?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Heh... Now that I think about it, this[n]is probably going to sound rather[n]absurd.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Don't worry.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: If it's your idea, Mako-chan, I'm sure[n]it'll be great.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm glad to hear you say that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, ready to hear it?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...Huh?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: So, any thoughts?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: What a great idea!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'd be honored to help.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Oh, thank you.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Well, I hope it works out.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mmhm, just leave it to me!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: But wow, Mako-chan... You come up[n]with some pretty bold moves sometimes.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I really look up to you for that.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Do you?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'm not sure how that makes me feel,[n]but thank you.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: The star will grant us our wish if[n]it's based on such a great plan.[n]I'm positive!
